title: backup: 0-byte dest file not cleaned up on Connection::open failure
description:
cmd_backup pre-creates dest_path with OpenOptions::create_new().mode(0o600). If Connection::open then fails, the ? propagates without removing the empty file. On retry, the exists() check at the top rejects with 'destination already exists', leaving the user stuck. The pre-creation was introduced in loop 1 as the TOCTOU fix.

Fix: wrap Connection::open in a block that calls std::fs::remove_file(&dest_path) before returning the error.
